ai_summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited reported robust Q2/H1 FY27 financial performance with total income soaring 309% and collections increasing 39% year-on-year, also achieving an upgraded AA positive credit outlook. A strategic decision to redesign the flagship Worli project, adding INR1,900 crores to its GDV for enhanced long-term profitability, will defer its launch to Q2 FY28. This deferral, coupled with a relatively modest Q2 booking value of INR298 crores and limited management transparency on gross presales, suggests potential near-term presales pressure and raises a minor concern regarding disclosure.
